name: talkwithagent
description: Keep Codex task execution connected to persistent web discussions.

interface.shortDescription: Discuss tasks in the web while Codex executes.
interface.longDescription: Bind a Codex session to a continuous web discussion with automatically synchronized visible context. Read discussion and confirmed feedback at checkpoints. Requires the TalkWithAgent npm command, Python 3.10+, and a signed-in Codex CLI.
